entities.basis: Named source of a recalled historical warning, u0134–u0144.

entities.label: Taster
entities.basis: Seeker explicitly names and keeps this rabbit at u0586–u0589.
entities.session_overview: Seeker names and keeps Taster after testing the stream water on him, and the party carries and protects the rabbit during the outpost exploration.

entities.label: Cavern ruler
entities.basis: Distinct ruler negotiates passage and guides the party; session note resolves her as Inakara, but that name is not spoken in this transcript.
entities.session_overview: The cavern ruler demands help against a creature in exchange for passage, guides the party to it, watches their battle, and afterward declines to guarantee their onward safety.

interactions.overview: Opening narration recalls the centaurs leaving to warn Candrosa about the corruption.
The party recalls Kisa’s account of raids while considering the creatures’ origin.
Seeker tests the stream water on a rabbit, names him Taster, and decides to keep him.

introduction.quote: Previously unnamed rabbit. I now dub thee Taster.

interactions.overview: Seeker tells the party to watch Taster for effects from the water.
Seeker takes Taster along as the party leaves the horses outside.
Someone protectively strokes Taster when Kenzo suggests testing the illusory rubble with him.
The party bargains for passage with the cavern ruler and follows her to the creature she demands they kill.

review_notes: Inakara is a secure identity match from the session note, but the transcript never supplies her name; the display label remains “Cavern ruler.”
Excluded generic roper, anonymous cavern inhabitants, departing centaurs, horses, rumored creatures, and incidental mention of Riswynn’s map-owning relative; combat still has its own scene.
“Tasty” at u0591 is an unconfirmed joking alternative for another rabbit; only Taster is clearly adopted and subsequently used.
Kisa’s information and Candrosa’s warning are reminders of prior events, not new meetings or evidence that either NPC is present.
The speaker of “Stroke the rabbit defensively” at u1306 is Unknown; the overview does not assign it to a particular PC.
The “40 minutes later” at u1261 occurs within a joke about geology, so it does not create a time skip.
Source excerpts are verbatim and retain transcript disfluencies. Scene indexes belong to this extraction, not the existing recap scenes.

Version 2 retest: full conversational encounters replace highlight-only bounds; original segmentation is retained for stable scene joins. NPC cards carry one session overview and a featured attributed quote where available.

Inakara’s negotiation and guided approach now form one interaction across scenes 13–15; combat observation and the subsequent exchange remain separate. Taster’s naming line is a PC introduction, not speech by the rabbit.

Version 3 adds important-item cards and one dominant type per scene; existing scene boundaries, indexes, dates and NPC encounter ranges are preserved. Extra NPC quotes stay inside the same conversations.
Item selection retains the consequential navigation maps; excludes ordinary weapons, armor, loose ball bearings and the outpost’s fixed mechanisms as inventory clutter.
